title: 无参数 MCP 请求在严格服务端挂起

history.evidence: Commit and diff demonstrate None params serializing as null; recorded strict Playwright server trace receives no tools/list response until the field is omitted. Both request and notification paths were fixed.

problem_zh: 某些严格的 MCP 服务对客户端发出的无参数操作始终不返回结果，最终表现为连接或工具发现超时；带参数调用通常正常。请修复请求与通知的兼容性，保留显式传入的参数内容和缺省参数的读取能力。
test_scope: Direct compilation of complete production Rust modules through #[path]; unrelated learner-profile dependency panics if invoked. No production function is copied.

redactions.old:
// MCP 服务器（如 @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 的 Zod 校验）把 experimental 定义为
    // optional record<string, unknown>；None 序列化成 null 会被判 invalid_type 而拒绝 initialize。
